data.text: Student A draws a monster in one minute. Student B asks questions to draw the same monster without looking: "How many eyes has it got? Has it got a beard?" Compare the drawings and laugh!

activities.title: Spot the differences!

data.script: Listen and match each person to a picture. There is one example. … Diego: Maya, which picture did you choose? … Maya: I chose the stomach. … Diego: Aiko, which picture did you choose? … Aiko: I chose the elbow. … Diego: Iris, which picture did you choose? … Iris: I chose the knee. … Diego: Lia, which picture did you choose? … Lia: I chose the finger. … Diego: Tino, which picture did you choose? … Tino: I chose the neck.

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the classroom? The girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass. … Maya: That is Maya. Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the boy with curly brown hair and a green shirt? … Maya: That is Bruno. Look, Bruno is running after the ball. … Diego: And who is the girl with a red ponytail and freckles? … Maya: That is Iris. Look, Iris is drawing with chalk on the ground. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey.
data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (nino, reportero) pregunta y Maya (nina, cientifica) responde.
